status: RESEARCH ONLY - NOT WRITTEN TO ANY out/regular FILE. See not_applied_because.
not_applied_because: There is no committed mechanism for injecting a researched everyday row into a store's out/regular file. audit-sale-fallback.ps1's header points at research-familyfare-everyday.ps1 as the model, and that script no longer exists in grocery/ - so the only way to apply these today would be a hand-edit of an 8 MB pipeline artifact produced by the 07:00/08:00 headless pull. That is improvisation on a file the chain rewrites, so the findings are banked here instead.

The Fareway rows below were read in a tab where retailerLocation 531573 could NOT be asserted (the shop.fareway.com Apollo cache read back empty and the session is signed out). The page reported In-Store and Omaha, but SKILL hard rule 4 says prove the store before trusting a price - so treat the Fareway prices as a research lead to be re-read by the sanctioned lane, not as board input.

items.gap: 0 rows in hyvee-regular-2026-08-28.json match the commodity's include patterns at all - the only bacon-bits cell on the board is the SALE row, so the store leaves the commodity when the sale ends.
items.root_cause: bacon-bits has NO entry in commodity-search.json terms (597 terms; 'pork-chops', 'red-wine' and 'white-wine' all have one, 'bacon-bits' does not). Hy-Vee's rotation can therefore never search for it. ADDING THE TERM IS THE REAL FIX; it is the same class as the commented-out 'NO SEARCH TERM' entries at the foot of the rescue lists.
